rule:
A space must not intersect walls, curtain walls, columns, slabs or roofs.
Source: rule 'Space Validation' of the EC3-2026 rule catalogue: This rule checks that space geometry and location are correct. It checks that space does not incorrectly intersect with slabs, walls or other components. This template focuses only on the 'intersect' check.
Benchmark convention: a space fails when its volume overlaps a wall, curtain wall, column, slab or roof by more than 30 mm; smaller overlaps at the space boundary are tolerated. Components lying entirely inside the space are covered by a separate check; doors, windows, furniture and other spaces are ignored.

Label every space.
Report the GlobalId of every element (modelled as IfcSpace) that does NOT satisfy this requirement.

solibri.configuration: The four rule sets of the EC3-2026 Solibri projects (ADA and ABA Accessibility Guidelines, Advanced Space Check, BIM Validation - Architectural, General Space Check) with their classifications, unchanged. EC3 models: their arc.smc; other models: ec3_template.smc (the EC3 smiley_west project with the model replaced through Update Models). Report template CheckingSummaryTemplate - Issue and Components.

reference.status: Labels taken from the Solibri issues of the rule (the authority, as in the EC3 benchmark).
reference.policy: FAIL: a scope element listed by an issue of the Solibri rule whose text matches the message; PASS: every other scope element.
reference.limitations: The geometric judgement is Solibri's and is not recomputed independently.
